message.content: {"caption":"Side-by-side line charts compare PPO and GRPO training rewards for two instruction-tuned models over 0–200 on the horizontal axis.","description":"Two line-chart panels show Training Reward on the vertical axis, with labeled ticks from 0.0 to 0.3; the plotted range extends a little above 0.3. The horizontal axes have ticks at 0, 50, 100, 150, and 200, with no axis title. In both panels, the legend identifies PPO as red and GRPO as blue. The left panel is labeled “(a) Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct”; the right is “(b) Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct.” Both series fluctuate as they rise. GRPO gains reward faster at the start, while PPO catches up; the curves finish at similar reward levels. In the Llama panel, PPO is around 0.32 at 150 and both lines finish near 0.35. In the Qwen panel, the lines converge around 0.3 toward the
